title: [Day 04] Incremental DOM mutations
text:
@cursor Final fixes for issue #4 on this PR (#14). Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts and QA), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and the final review above first.

Push to the existing branch `day-04/dom-mutations`. Do not open a new PR. Do not change earlier parts except what these fixes need.

1. Privacy leak: a node added inside an existing blocked element (`data-rewind-block`, or any element `elementIsBlocked` matches) is recorded in full.
   - First a test commit `test(recorder): reproduce add inside blocked element (#4)` in `packages/recorder/src/observers/mutation.test.ts`: snapshot a page with a blocked div, append a span with secret text into it, flush. Expect no add for it and that the secret text appears nowhere in the event (`JSON.stringify(event)` does not contain it). Also cover moving an existing node into the blocked element: only its remove is recorded.
   - Then `fix(recorder): skip adds inside blocked elements (#4)` in `packages/recorder/src/observers/mutation.ts`: in `emitAdd` also skip nodes whose parent chain (use the existing `ancestor` and `insideBlocked`, starting from the parent) contains a blocked element.
2. `siblingId` must not create a new id. Use the first following sibling that `ctx.mirror.has()`, else `null`. Add a test (test commit first), then `fix(recorder): use only known ids for nextId (#4)`.

If a fix changes what an older test expects, put that change in its own `test: fix <what> (#4)` commit with the reason. Do not weaken or delete
